units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 11:4:2">Y. Ter. XI, 47ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>במחוסרים למַצְמֵץ</he> when they are too poor to be sucked out. Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ <he>שלא יקלף בתאנים וִימַצְמֵץ בענבים</he> he must not peel (taste the surface of) the figs or take a suck of the grapes (and throw them away); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:4:10">Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ומצמץ</he> (read: <he>ומְמַצְמֵץ</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:6">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (expl. <he>משתאה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:21">Gen. XXIV, 21</cite>, as if fr. <cite ref="U02078"><he>שָׁתָה</he></cite>) <he>מְמַצְמֵץ ומביט בה</he> he sipped (the water which she handed him) and looked at her; Yalk. ib. 109.
